surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 26 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Ghaashiya (The Overwhelming) is the 88th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 26 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم هل اتاك حديث الغاشية
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Have you heard tell [Prophet] about the Overwhelming Event

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day, there will be downcast faces

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Working [hard] and exhausted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: toiling and weary

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: as they enter the blazing Fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will be given drink from a boiling spring
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and are forced to drink from a boiling spring

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ ضَرِيعٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ليس لهم طعام الا من ضريع
ayahs.translation_saheeh: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with no food for them except bitter dry thorns

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنْ جُوعٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا يسمن ولا يغني من جوع
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that neither nourish nor satisfy hunger

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day there will also be faces radiant with bliss

ayahs.translation_saheeh: With their effort [they are] satisfied
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: well pleased with their labour

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In an elevated garden
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in a lofty garden

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: where they will hear no idle talk

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Within it is a flowing spring
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with a flowing spring

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Within it are couches raised high
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: raised couches

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And cups put in place
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: goblets placed before them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And cushions lined up
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: cushions set in rows

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And carpets spread around
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and carpets spread

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَفَلَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
ayahs.arabic_clean: افلا ينظرون الى الابل كيف خلقت
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do the disbelievers not see how rain clouds are formed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And at the sky - how it is raised
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: how the heavens are lifted

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And at the mountains - how they are erected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: how the mountains are raised high

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And at the earth - how it is spread out
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: how the earth is spread out

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] warn them: your only task is to give warning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: You are not over them a controller
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you are not there to control them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: However, he who turns away and disbelieves
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: As for those who turn away and disbelieve

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God will inflict the greatest torment upon them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, to Us is their return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It is to Us they will return

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then indeed, upon Us is their account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and then it is for Us to call them to account
